scenarios.title: Three blocked issues with no way out
scenarios.source: Audit RC5: 19 of 20 PAR issues and all 14 PARA issues were blocked with no unblock descriptor, so nothing could wake them.
scenarios.situation:
It is a weekday morning in company PAR. The company brief's health list says: "3 issues are blocked with no way out for over a day".
- PAR-701 "Draft the Hunt and Gun newsletter", assigned to the Account Manager (agent id am-1). Blocked because the client has not sent their logo. No unblock descriptor, no question to the owner.
- PAR-702 "Follow up the Agri Studies quote", assigned to the Deal Desk (agent id dd-1). Blocked by PAR-690, which is done.
- PAR-703 "Post the Elza Cilliers launch on Instagram", assigned to the Social agent (agent id so-1). It needs the owner to connect the Instagram account: a login only the owner can give.
In this exercise an issue's id is its identifier. The company prefix is PAR.
scenarios.task: Give each of the three blocked issues the way out the Operator skill requires.

forbid.reason: an agent never assigns an issue to a person: people get questions through ask-owner

unblockDescriptor.action: Ask the client for the logo and attach it

args.question: Please connect the Elza Cilliers Instagram account
args.why: The launch post cannot be published without it
steps: Sign in as the account owner

pass.summary: Gave each blocked issue a way out.

scenarios.title: A routine that failed because of a plugin bug
scenarios.source: Audit Q5-8: Run today's SEO failed 5 of 5 times (a manifest bug) and nothing said so.
scenarios.situation: The System health issue lists: "Routine 'Run today's SEO' failed its last run". The schedule fired but created no issue, so that work did not happen. The routine is rt-9 and belongs to the SEO plugin; its assignee is the SEO Specialist (agent id seo-1). Its run log says: invalid input syntax for type uuid: "routine:seo-daily". That is a bug in the plugin's own routine template, not a setting. No Developer is staffed in Setup → Team. The owner is user owner-1.
scenarios.task: What do you do about this failed routine?

forbid.reason: only the routine's assignee may run it, and running it again would fail the same way

args.question: Who should fix the SEO plugin's daily routine template?
args.why: It fails on every run because of a plugin bug; no Developer is staffed

plan.say: plugin bug, needs someone who owns code

pass.summary: A plugin bug: asked the owner, did not retry.

scenarios.title: Agents that cannot use memory: the owner is already asked
scenarios.source: Audit Q9-6 and RC5: seven agents had no tools:use grant; the Cockpit asks the owner once, with an effect, so the Operator must not ask again or grant anything.
scenarios.situation: The System health list has a row: "Agents that cannot use company memory: Code Reviewer, Planner and Delivery Lead have no tools:use grant." The Cockpit's waiting list already carries one open question to the owner about exactly this (ask ak-12, opened this morning). Its first option grants the four memory tools to those agents and checks the grant afterwards.
scenarios.task: What do you do about this health row?

forbid.reason: the Cockpit has already asked, and a second question is noise
an agent never grants tool access itself

mustSay: already|do not ask again|waiting on the owner|open question

plan.say: The Cockpit has already asked the owner (ask ak-12); I wait for the answer and do not ask again or grant anything.

pass.summary: Nothing to do: the owner is already asked.

scenarios.title: A grant the answer must carry out
scenarios.source: Audit critic M-grants: the Operator asked for the mailbox delegation 5 times in 5 days, the owner answered each time, and the delegation was never created.
scenarios.situation: The Operator's inbound-reply work (PAR-480) cannot start: it needs read and draft access to the shared mailbox info@partnersinbiz.online (mailbox account id mb-7) for the Account Manager (agent id am-1). Only the owner can set up delegation. You asked about this five times before in free text; the owner answered each time and nothing changed. The Mailbox plugin can carry out a delegation when the owner says yes.
scenarios.task: Ask the owner so that their answer actually creates the delegation.

args.question: Let the Account Manager read and draft in info@partnersinbiz.online?
steps: Add the Account Manager with read and draft

plan.say: Hi, could you please grant the delegation when you have a minute?

scenarios.title: A question to the owner is short, plain and names who does what
scenarios.source: Karpathy's note of 2026-10-02: more of the job is reading what models write. Audit: ask-owner cards and briefs were long and hedged.
scenarios.situation: It is a weekday morning in company PAR. Issue PAR-720 "Renew the Hunt and Gun domain" is assigned to the Account Manager (agent id am-1). The registrar will renew hunt-and-gun.co.za for R 289 on 12 October. Renewal needs the owner to pay: a card payment only the owner can make. If it lapses, the site and the client's email stop. Pay link: /PAR/billing?tab=payments. In this exercise an issue's id is its identifier. The company prefix is PAR.
scenarios.task: Ask the owner for the payment. Write the question, why it matters and the steps exactly as the owner will read them.

args.question: Please pay R 289 to renew hunt-and-gun.co.za before 12 October.
args.why: If the domain lapses, the client's website and email stop.

pass.summary: Asked the owner to pay the renewal.

args.question: Prior to the expiry of the registration on 12 October, it should be ensured that the renewal fee is paid, as the domain might possibly lapse otherwise; kindly utilize the payment page when convenient and let us know.
